description: Use this when the signed-in account needs an additional email address (for example one per agent, project, or customer). Requires auth. Inputs: username (required; becomes <username>@cooperemail.com), display_name (optional From name). Returns the new inbox {id, username, email, display_name, created_at, require_sender_auth}. Fails with 409 inbox_exists if the address is taken, or 402 with upgrade_url if the plan's inbox limit is reached.

username.description: Local part of the new address, becoming username@cooperemail.com

name: cooper_create_inbox
title: Create another inbox
